svg.title: 沿着来路
svg.desc: AI辅助题字母版经Alpha轮廓算法重建的真实路径。非字库转曲，非人工手写；保留自然字形与少量飞白。
svg.metadata:
{"text": "沿着来路", "source": "along-the-route-master.png", "sourceSha256": "049a5d5121d831fa5235b5865acc7ecf425ec158851a0430471430335b7729d1", "sourceType": "AI-assisted lettering generated with built-in image_gen; not human handwriting, a font, or font outlines", "generationTool": "image_gen.imagegen", "generationModel": "not exposed by built-in tool", "transparent_background": true, "referenced_image_paths": null, "promptFile": "along-the-route-prompt.txt", "prompt": "Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Independent original-style Chinese calligraphic four-character title master for a memorial website; to be traced from alpha into vector paths.
Primary request: Create a transparent-background Chinese brush-lettering artwork accurately reading “沿着来路”, exactly these four simplified Chinese characters in one horizontal line.
Text (verbatim): "沿着来路"
Character sequence: 沿 / 着 / 来 / 路. The second character is 着 with 羊-like top and 目 below. Do not substitute characters.
Style/medium: powerful restrained Chinese running script 行书 with monumental inscription 碑刻 bone structure. Strong upright and downward strokes, full thick brush bellies, angular cut-tip endings and just a few intentional dry-brush gaps. Natural character construction with clearly visible vertical strength. Bold living brush silhouette, but reliably legible. This must look like a related family to vigorous Chinese memorial brush titles.
Composition/framing: Four characters left to right in a single line. Build each character naturally tall, close to square or slightly taller than square; do NOT squeeze their bodies flat. Make the total ink silhouette width-to-height ratio approximately 3.8:1, strictly between 3.5 and 4.3. Tall stems and substantial character height, modest spacing between characters. Natural slight height variation. No long horizontal tail, no underline, no surrounding decorative mark. Leave transparent whitespace on all four sides.
Color palette: flat dark ink green #183e31 throughout. True transparent background with transparent dry-brush gaps.
Constraints: typography only, exactly four characters. Accurate character structure and natural proportions outrank dramatic flourishes. No paper, background, seal, border, calligrapher signature, watermark, shadows, glow, metallic effects, texture-filled background, gradients, duplicate strokes, English, or any additional text. Do not imitate a normal typeset font.
", "method": "Threshold generated alpha, median filter, remove isolated regions under 16px, reconstruct spline contours with vtracer 0.6.15; no manual stroke redrawing", "parameters": {"alphaThreshold": 128, "medianFilterSize": 3, "minimumConnectedArea": 16, "padding": 48, "colormode": "binary", "mode": "spline", "filter_speckle": 4, "corner_threshold": 60, "length_threshold": 6.0, "splice_threshold": 45, "path_precision": 3}, "characterGeometry": "unaltered; no anisotropic scaling", "characterTranslationsX": [0, 100, 200, 300], "processedAlphaSha256": "ba088bd02235a95eb70356c8f4f8d2f19f7ade3de450d2724c17c096bc47a1b2", "inkDimensions": [2265, 608], "inkAspectRatio": 3.725329}
